questions.prompt: OpenAI custom voices: what must the consent recording contain?

options.text: Any short sentence that says yes
options.explanation: The OpenAI docs say any divergence from OpenAI's consent phrases leads to a failure.

options.text: Only one of OpenAI's consent phrases
options.explanation: Right. The OpenAI docs say the recording must only include one of OpenAI's phrases, and any divergence from the script fails.

options.text: The same words as the voice sample
options.explanation: The sample is separate. The consent recording must be one of OpenAI's fixed phrases.

questions.prompt: Whose voice can you use for an ElevenLabs Professional Voice Clone?

options.explanation: The ElevenLabs docs say even with their consent, you cannot clone someone else's voice as a Professional Voice Clone.

options.text: Any voice in the Voice Library
options.explanation: The ElevenLabs docs say a Professional Voice Clone can only be of your own voice.
Right. The ElevenLabs docs say you can only create a Professional Voice Clone of your own voice, checked by a verification step.

questions.prompt: What do the ElevenLabs docs say the ElevenLabs voice captcha check can prove?

options.text: That the requester was there and took part
options.explanation: Right. The ElevenLabs docs say it confirms the requester was present and actively participating, not that the recording is theirs.

options.text: That the recording legally belongs to them
options.explanation: The ElevenLabs docs say verification cannot guarantee that the recording truly belongs to the requester.

options.text: That every later use will be authorised
options.explanation: ElevenLabs places the responsibility for authorised use with the creator, not with the check.
